SELECT
    [CASE_NUMBER] AS [xg_externalid],

    CASE
        WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE_TYPE))) = 'INVESTIGATION' THEN 171060016
        WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE_TYPE))) = 'CASE MANAGEMENT' THEN 171060024
        WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE_TYPE))) = 'PERMANENCY' THEN 171060022
        WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE_TYPE))) = 'PRIVATE PERMANENCY' THEN 292460001
        WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE_TYPE))) = 'ADOPTION' THEN 171060032
        WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE_TYPE))) = 'EXTENDED FOSTER CARE' THEN 171060028
        WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE_TYPE))) = 'APPEAL' THEN 171060006
        WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE_TYPE))) = 'GUARDIANSHIP' THEN 171060031
        WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE_TYPE))) = 'ICPC' THEN 171060019
        WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE_TYPE))) = 'ICAMA' THEN 292460002
        WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE_TYPE))) = 'POST-PERMANENCY SERVICE' THEN 171060020
        WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE_TYPE))) = 'STANDARDS COMPLAINT CASE' THEN 292460000
        WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE_TYPE))) = 'PROVIDER SERVICE' THEN 171060033
        WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE_TYPE))) = 'Family Service' THEN 541120001
        ELSE NULL
    END AS xg_casetype,

    CASE
        WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE_STATUS))) = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1
        WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(CASE_STATUS))) = 'CLOSED' THEN 2
        ELSE NULL
    END AS statuscode,

    [OPEN_DATE] AS xg_caseopendate,
    [CLOSE_DATE] AS xg_caseclosedate,
    [CLOSE_REASON] AS xg_closurereason,
    [FRAME_CREATED_DATE] AS overriddencreatedon,
    [FRAME_MODIFIED_DATE] AS xgi_overridemodifieddate,
    CAST('fa1abe76-6b34-ef11-8409-6045bdd63e76' AS uniqueidentifier) AS OwnerId,
    'systemuser' AS OwnerIdType
FROM [STAGING].[FRAME_CASE];
